violations.description: Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --Cloth for wiping food spills was not stored in sanitizing solution (at proper concentration) between uses. Establishment using 409 cleaner as cleaning/sanitizing agent on food contact surfaces. Recommend using approved sanitizer.

Variance requirement for specialized processing methods. — --Food establishment did not obtain approved variance or HACCP plan from regulatory authority for special process of vacuum sealing raw meats.

General equipment and utensils - Maintenance and operation. — --Nonfood contact equipment/utensil was not maintained in a good repair or sound condition. Particle board shelving/cabinets have peeling laminate. Exposed bare wood.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Food contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. Upper shelving in meat dept. walk in cooler has mold build up and needs cleaning. (may need replacing). Fan guards in produce walk in cooler have build up of dust and need cleaning.

Plumbing system. — --Plumbing system was not designed, constructed, operated and/or maintained according to regulation. Walk in cooler compressors have drain lines draining into 5 gallon buckets inside coolers. Should be plumbed outside units.
Handwashing lavatories. — --Handwashing lavatory was not provided in sufficient number and/or not accessible to allow convenient use by employees. Hand wash station not provided in meat dept. area.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Floors in walk in coolers have food/debris build up and need cleaning. Ceiling in produce walk in cooler has dust build up from compressor fans and needs cleaning.

General equipment and utensils - Materials and design. — --Material of food contact surface was not constructed or designed to be smooth, nonabsorbent and cleanable. - Areas of paint that seals the wood is chipping off from shelves in walk-in cooler. Needs spot painting to keep sealed.
